text:
3 Stars

I’ve been coming to this clinic for dental checkups and cleanings for more than five years. The dentist herself is good. She is skilled, professional, and does quality work, which is the main reason I kept returning over the years.

Unfortunately, the scheduling at this clinic has always been a problem.

For my latest appointment, I received multiple reminders — a voicemail, a text message, and an email confirming the time. I arrived five minutes early like a normal patient should. I then sat in the waiting area for 35 minutes past my appointment time, only to be told to go upstairs and wait another 20 minutes.

That’s when I decided to leave. Another customer also walked out at the same time for the same reason.

Here’s what I don’t understand: the clinic clearly has the ability to call, text, email, and leave voicemails to remind patients about appointments. If the clinic knows they are running significantly behind schedule, why not use that same system to inform patients before they arrive?

Instead, patients show up on time and are expected to sit and wait indefinitely.

One of the staff mentioned they are short staffed. If that’s the case, then appointments should be scheduled with more realistic timing instead of stacking patients back-to-back and making everyone wait.

The dentist may be good, but the clinic’s scheduling system shows very little respect for the patient’s time. A doctor’s time is not more important than the customer’s time.

After five years of being a patient here, walking out of my appointment because of poor scheduling was disappointing. Unless the clinic improves how it manages appointments, I will likely find another dentist in Pattaya who respects their patients’ time.

After a thorough examination and multiple X-rays, the dentist carefully explained that the real source of my pain was not the tooth I suspected, but a severely damaged wisdom tooth with decay reaching the nerve. He even used a dental model to help me fully understand the diagnosis and treatment options.
I have had dental anxiety since childhood and previously experienced a very traumatic wisdom tooth extraction. Because of that, I was extremely nervous. However, the dentist and his assistants were exceptional. Throughout the procedure, they continuously reassured me, helped manage my stress, and made me feel safe and comfortable. Their kindness, patience, and professionalism played a huge role in building my trust and helping me stay calm.
The extraction itself was smooth, efficient, and far less traumatic than my previous experience. The dentist's skill and confidence were evident throughout the entire treatment.
Today, I am very grateful that I chose Dental Smile Pattaya. They not only solved a serious problem during my travels, but also restored my confidence in dental treatment.
To the dentist and the entire team: thank you for your professionalism, compassion, patience, and genuine care. I would confidently recommend Dental Smile Pattaya to anyone, especially travelers and patients who may feel nervous or uncertain about seeking dental care away from home.
And finally, I apologize for the length of this review. I simply wanted to make sure I properly acknowledged the outstanding care I received and gave credit where it was truly deserved.

Thank you again for everything.

I came to Dental Smile Pattaya for a significant amount of dental work and the experience has genuinely changed the way I feel about my smile and my confidence.
My dentist was Dr. Jureeporn Piladist, and I cannot speak highly enough of her. She was warm, caring, patient and extremely thorough throughout the whole process. I had a full set of zirconia crowns across my upper teeth, including a bridge, as well as a professional cleaning and whitening of my lower teeth.
The main treatment took around a week, but what impressed me just as much as the finished result was the aftercare. Dr. Jureeporn saw me repeatedly afterwards and continued making small adjustments to my bite until I was completely comfortable. There was never any feeling that the job was simply “finished” once the crowns were fitted. She wanted to make sure everything felt right.
I am also a very nervous dental patient. I have a strong airway reflex and can sometimes panic and instinctively stop breathing when something unfamiliar is in my mouth. Dr. Jureeporn and her team handled this exceptionally well. They were calm, reassuring and never made me feel embarrassed or difficult. A sedative was used during the more demanding treatment, which worked extremely well and allowed me to remain unusually relaxed. I reached the point where I genuinely trusted them.
The whole team at Dental Smile were incredibly friendly and caring. From the dentists and assistants to the reception staff, I felt looked after rather than simply treated as another patient.
And the result is fantastic. For the first time in my life I actually love my teeth and my smile. The zirconia crowns look natural, clean and beautifully made. It has made a real difference to my self-confidence.
For anyone travelling from the UK and considering dental treatment in Thailand, I would strongly recommend speaking to Dental Smile Pattaya. For the amount of work I had done, the cost was a fraction of what I would have expected to pay for comparable treatment in the UK, while the level of care, attention and aftercare I received was exceptional.
A huge thank you to Dr. Jureeporn and the entire Dental Smile team. I will remember what you did for me for a very long time.
